crossRefs.note: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off…
It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of…
Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and…
